implementation: Every rendered set of online controls receives an opaque, memory-only token bound to UID, room and seat. Selection-only redraws also replace the token.

The event dispatcher validates that token and context and requires the online view before sending ordinary, primary, numeric, mana-payment and confirmed moves, or creating, joining and cancelling rooms.
Navigation outside the online screen and identity changes revoke the current scope. Existing revision, turn, connection and busy guards remain.
onlineMove also refuses calls outside the online view. No request payload, server schema, persistence format, card ID, deck or historical match data changed.

verification.formatOnlyAfterCheck: The dispatcher declaration was moved to a separate line after the passing checks; node --check app.js and online-ui.js passed afterwards.

coverage: Delayed ordinary, primary, number, mana and confirmed events after leaving and returning to the same match are rejected; fresh controls still commit.
Matching action IDs and revisions in another room cannot reuse an old control.
Logout/login to the same UID and switching to another account and match invalidate old actions.
Missing or incorrect context tokens cannot send mutations.
Old primary and ordinary controls after a selection-only change at the same revision are rejected.
Create, join and waiting-room cancellation controls require the currently rendered lobby context.
All specialized renderers carry escaped opaque context and do not expose the account UID.
Existing revision-only negative tests now explicitly supply the current context so their original revision validation coverage is retained.
Existing resignation, offline result panel, uncertain-response recovery, mana selection, numeric validation, account persistence and navigation regressions pass.
limits: This fix was verified using the actual-app VM, real HTTP handler and encrypted isolated storage, plus renderer and client regressions; no new real-browser session was run for this fix.
Not exhaustive testing of every card, game state or browser.
Production verification awaits an explicitly authorized release.
Two user-deferred ruling/reprint items and interrupted historical whole-suite status retained.
